text:
mia: kicking off a 1% canary for v0.7-q2-affine-kv now. goal: 30m smoke + A/B slices (longdocs, rerank). watching latency p95, MRR delta, and hallucination proxy. will post quick numbers.

sanjay: great — include short-answers slice and low-confidence rerank slice. also log cost/token so we can check unit economics.

mia: added slices. config snippet: 

```
canary:
  traffic: 1%
  duration: 30m
  slices: [longdocs>2k, short-answers, low_conf_rerank]
  metrics: [mrr, latency_p95_ms, token_cost, hallucination_proxy]
  autofallback_rules:
    mrr_drop_pct: 1.0
    latency_p95_delta_ms: 40
    short_answers_em_drop_pct: 1.0
```

kate: baseline -> canary after first 10k requests: latency p95 +18ms, token_cost -22% (nice), overall MRR -0.9% (within 1.0). hallucination_proxy +0.2% (low).

ev: what about the short-answers slice? that usually bites int4 variants.

mia: short-answers EM dropped 1.7% on the slice (exceeds short_answers_em_drop_pct). slice-level rule triggered.

deploy-bot: autosafety: rollback triggered by rule short_answers_em_drop_pct at 3289901143. Rolling v0.7-q2-affine-kv -> v0.6-stable for affected slice. :warning:

sanjay: ack. good to see slice-level rule working. can we capture examples for the short-answers regressions and run targeted introspective eval?

kate: saving payloads + model outputs to /eval/short-answers/canary-3289901111. also adding tokenizer_seed alignment test.

mia: plan: try hybrid-int8 bridge + kv warmup, re-run short-answers on a 0.5% micro-canary tomorrow. if EM delta <0.8% and latency p95 delta <30ms, promote. otherwise keep fallback.

ev: add a check for top-token distribution shift (KL) > 0.02 as an additional early-warning.

mia: noted. will post the micro-canary schedule and final triage notes here. thanks all :thumbsup:
